constraints.title: Scoped identity
constraints.statement: A resource identity, association, provider mapping or artifact provenance retains its intended owner/resource/account/type context; a bare reference does not confer authority.

constraints.title: Independent tailoring
constraints.statement: A shared source edit alone cannot change existing resume drafts, live presentations, other resumes or their independent text.

constraints.title: Separate publication
constraints.statement: Explicit selected draft application and separately confirmed publication are different operations; successful apply alone does not change live presentation.

constraints.title: Actual historical independence
constraints.statement: Later source/resume/letter/publication edits do not overwrite the actual previously submitted material; authorized correction/resubmission retains distinguishable context under reviewed policy. The accepted core is independence; correction details remain proposed.

constraints.title: Selected disclosure
constraints.statement: Employer context exposes only the intended selected published representation and applicable PDF variant; direct file retrieval is not a bypass.

constraints.title: Independent representation dimensions
constraints.statement: Publication, download-mode eligibility, artifact availability and current protected access remain independently distinguishable facts.

constraints.title: Completeness is an evidence claim
constraints.statement: Submitted application progress, complete preserved actual material, provider acceptance and recipient receipt are distinct claims; missing material cannot be labeled complete.

constraints.title: Current scoped authority
constraints.statement: Every consequential protected operation uses its applicable current exact-scope policy; initial sign-in or a membership on another resource does not grant universal authority.

constraints.title: Provider/local separation
constraints.statement: A local association, provider object and provider capability have different authority; local unlink is not provider delete, and reconnect does not itself establish fresh synchronized state.

constraints.title: Work and period meaning
constraints.statement: Task progress, backlog-item criteria/acceptance and Sprint period/goal outcomes stay distinct; one Sprint Backlog combines goal, selected items and delivery plan.

constraints.title: Evaluated revision context
constraints.statement: Reviews/checks, integration and workflow results retain evaluated repository/revision context rather than treating moving ref names as identical evidence.

constraints.title: Attempt and target separation
constraints.statement: A run, its actual attempts, outputs and independently authorized target effects are distinguishable. Cancellation requested is not confirmed stop; retry is a distinct attempt.

constraints.title: Effective versus requested policy
constraints.statement: Only actually confirmed effective policy governs a claimed new allowance; admission eligibility is not proof of a usable artifact or freed capacity.

constraints.title: Reference-aware retirement
constraints.statement: Archive/unlink/trash/reclaim are distinct; removal must respect category authority, required references and reviewed retention, not silently erase protected actual history.

constraints.title: Language/time provenance
constraints.statement: Manual variant identity and required event/recorded/displayed-time meaning remain distinguishable; missing precision/language/context is not guessed or automatically translated.

constraints.title: Recovery evidence and access
constraints.statement: Restored bytes or a completed backup do not establish scoped usable recovery; required integrity/current access/external-state checks and measured criteria must actually be assessed.

constraints.title: Truthful observed effects
constraints.statement: Denied, definite failed, partial, confirmed pending and unknown effects have different meanings; a missing/failed response does not universally prove previous subject state or rollback.

constraints.title: No implicit consequential propagation
constraints.statement: Save, connection recovery, merge, build/release and data restore do not automatically authorize publication, provider resend/replay, deployment or restored old rights. Each needs its relevant exact contract.

contracts.preconditions: Current cancellation authority and actual attempt context identified; distinguish queued work from running work.
contracts.success: Request establishes cancellation-requested only; cancelled/stop result is claimed only after actual matching termination or queue cancellation is confirmed.
contracts.frame: Known effects/output remain attributable; no guarantee that prior side effects are reversed.
contracts.exceptions: Completion may win race; still-alive means pending stop; lost stop/result evidence remains unknown, not cancelled.
contracts.concurrency: Reconcile same attempt; repeated cancel cannot imply duplicate execution or prove termination; actual completion/stop observations govern.
contracts.gate: Cancellation-requested is a proposed analysis refinement; no signal/timeout/kill escalation mechanism or bound selected.

contracts.title: Request a separate eligible retry attempt

contracts.preconditions: Current execution gates still satisfied; prior uncertain consequential effect is reconciled sufficiently under reviewed retry contract; no blind relaunch of possibly live work.
contracts.success: Actually admitted retry is a distinguishable new attempt with intended evaluated context; it does not relabel old attempt.
contracts.frame: Prior actual attempt evidence and independently affected target/material history remain distinguishable.
contracts.exceptions: Unmet gate/unknown unsafe prior disposition prevents a claimed eligible retry; retry admission is not success.
contracts.concurrency: Re-evaluate changed code/definition/authority and actual prior effects; no automatic retry count or same-attempt transition to Queued invented.
contracts.gate: Retry is new attempt; detailed repetition/reconciliation policy remains proposed, not a chosen idempotency protocol.
